dataset.source: Bundled synthetic legal contracts (datasets/legal-contracts). Original text authored for RAG Workbench.

label: baseline prompt | max_evidence=4 | seed=0
limitations: Small and synthetic: it demonstrates the answer pipeline, not legal accuracy.
Reference answers are manually verified against the bundled contract text only.
Whether a cited passage genuinely supports a claim is not deterministically decidable and is not scored here.
Retrieval is BM25 by default; dense/rerank results depend on the installed optional extras and the chosen configuration.
Generation depends on the local model; answer quality is not comparable across models without re-running the set.

Reference coverage is a lexical-anchor check: complete coverage means the required anchors reached the context, not that the model used them correctly. Factual correctness and semantic support require human review.
